title: Executive Leadership Intensive
blurb: Three days onsite for directors and VPs, followed by 90 days of executive coaching. Strategy, influence, and leading leaders in the AI era.

modules.body:
Onsite agenda

Strategy articulation, portfolio prioritization, and decision quality under uncertainty — with AI-assisted scenario modeling and devil's-advocate exercises on your real strategic options. Case work drawn from real institutional transformations.

Onsite agenda

Influence without authority, executive communication and data storytelling, and building leadership benches beneath you.

🧪 Interactive Lab — try it now

Act as my executive sparring partner. My strategic decision: [describe]. Run scenario modeling (90 days, three futures), then a devil’s-advocate attack on my preferred path, then a board-ready one-page recommendation with risks, mitigations, and the metric that proves it worked.

modules.d: AI-era operating models and change at scale.
modules.body:
Onsite agenda

Operating-model redesign, AI governance at the executive level, the business case for adoption, and your personal transformation charter.

Coaching structure

Bi-weekly 1:1 sessions with your executive mentor against your transformation charter, with a final sponsor debrief.
